verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles computes profile features: entities and attributes are declared in YAML and compiled to warehouse SQL with feature aggregation (docs-35, docs-31, docs-60). Audiences can be built on warehouse sources and synced downstream for targeting (docs-27, docs-6). Nothing in the evidence shows predictive scores such as LTV, churn or purchase propensity, and feature definition is code-based YAML rather than a marketer UI. Missing for 10: predictive LTV/churn/propensity scoring, explicit evidence that computed traits feed audience targeting, a marketer-friendly trait builder, independent corroboration.
